stops.note: Jules Léotard, a gymnast from Toulouse, performed the first flying-trapeze act at the Cirque Napoléon in Paris on 12 November 1859, wearing a one-piece knitted costume
the 1867 music-hall song 'The Daring Young Man on the Flying Trapeze' was about him; his name for the garment is recorded in English from the 1920s

current_meaning: a close-fitting one-piece garment worn by dancers and gymnasts
